module: Computation of the player's reputation with career organizations. Value between -50 and 700, converted to a level (-1 to 3 by default: questionable, neutral, reliable, preferred, partner) with, per level, the share withheld on loaned vehicles (loanerCut) and the delivery bonus (deliveryBonus). The raw value is the <orgId>Reputation attribute of playerAttributes.
notes: Default thresholds (requiredValue): -50, -25, 40, 175, 400. Organizations can override via organization.reputationLevels.
addReputationToOrg modifies the organization object: merges the defaults into reputationLevels, translates label/levelLabel and writes organization.reputation.
The returned level is (found index - 2); addReputationToOrg therefore assumes reputationLevels starts at level -1.

addReputationToOrg.desc: Computes the organization's reputation and attaches it as organization.reputation = {value, level, curLvlProgress, neededForNext, prevThreshold, nextThreshold}; also fills in the levels with the default values.

organization.desc: Organization (id, reputationLevels). Does nothing if nil.

getLabel.desc: Translated label of the default reputation level.

returns.desc: Label, or empty string if unknown.

getValueForEvent.desc: Reputation change associated with an event.
